add_external_corpus: add external corpus for ngram speculative decoding from file path or documents list
remove_external_corpus: remove external corpus by corpus id from ngram speculative decoding cache
flush_cache: flush the scheduler cache with an optional timeout in seconds
update_weights_from_tensor: update model weights from tensor input with optional weight version and abort handling
load_lora_adapter: load a LoRA adapter from a path with LRU eviction and max-loaded limit enforcement
